name: Himachal Pradesh State Data Centre (HPSDC), Mehli
developer: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Department of Digital Technologies and Governance (DITHP)
notes: Official HP Digital Technologies dept page confirms HPSDC commissioned 30 May 2016 to host e-governance applications under NeGP; DCD (8 Jun 2016) and Financial Express report CM Virbhadra Singh inaugurated it at Mehli, Shimla as India's first 'green' data centre (Rs 58 crore; 101 services, HIMSWAN connectivity). Government SDC in Shimla district; no commercial colocation. MW capacity not disclosed.

name: HPSEBL Data Centre, Vidyut Bhawan
developer: Himachal Pradesh State Electricity Board Ltd (HPSEBL)
notes: Recurring HPSEBL IT maintenance/AMC tenders reference a data centre at Vidyut Bhawan, Shimla paired with a disaster-recovery centre at Paonta Sahib (Sirmaur). Small government utility facility; capacity and exact status not published. Evidence limited to tender aggregator snippets (weak secondary).

name: HPSEBL Disaster Recovery Centre, Paonta Sahib
developer: Himachal Pradesh State Electricity Board Ltd (HPSEBL)
notes: HPSEBL IT tender listings reference a Disaster Recovery Centre at Paonta Sahib (Sirmaur district) supporting the HPSEBL data centre at Vidyut Bhawan, Shimla. Small DR facility for the state electricity utility; no MW published; status inferred operational from recurring maintenance tenders. Tender aggregator snippets only.

name: Himachal Cyber City, Waknaghat
developer: Government of Himachal Pradesh - Department of Digital Technologies and Governance
notes: The Tribune (11 Oct 2025, verified directly) reports CM Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced a Cyber City over 650 bighas at Waknaghat, Solan district to house data storage, AI and other IT enterprises; detailed blueprint not yet finalised; adjacent Centre of Excellence at Waknaghat under construction with planned AI lab. No private developer or MW capacity named - treat as announced pipeline, not a facility.

name: Jammu and Kashmir State Data Centre (SDC), Civil Secretariat Jammu
developer: Jammu and Kashmir Information Technology Department / JaKeGA / C-DAC
notes: J&K e-Governance Agency (JaKeGA) pages reference the State Data Centre and its maintenance windows; Kashmir Images (Aug 2022) reports MeitY Secretary visited the J&K State Data Centre Jammu; June 2022 reporting says the modernised Civil Secretariat Jammu facility was inaugurated, managed by C-DAC with the J&K IT Department. AS148144/148145 registered as 'State Data Centre Jammu'. Capacity not disclosed; operational government SDC.

name: IIT Jammu Data Center and Operations Management / Agastya HPC
notes: Official IIT Jammu Digital Infrastructure page describes a centralised data centre supporting research/learning/enterprise services, including Agastya HPC (82 nodes, 256 TF) and private-cloud clusters. Institutional/research facility in Jammu district; not commercial colocation; MW not disclosed.
